title: Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. translated_title: 预训练优化器的增益能否迁移到KL蒸馏？
translated_abstract: 矩阵结构优化器可以改善语言模型的预训练，但这些增益是否能迁移到从指令微调初始化出发的短程KL蒸馏中尚不明确。我们在统一的forward-KL目标和固定训练预算下，将AdamW和对角AdaGrad与两种可行的Shampoo简化版本、SOAP以及All-2D Muon进行了比较，实验覆盖四个稠密Qwen师生模型对。在各个模型规模上，没有任何一个被评估的矩阵结构优化方案在质量与训练时间的权衡上能持续优于逐元素基线：AdamW通常达到最低的验证KL，而AdaGrad在更大规模下可能略快一些。SOAP的KL表现通常接近AdamW，但会带来显著的训练时间开销；两种Shampoo简化版本在不同模型对之间的性能排序会发生颠倒，这表明结论依赖于具体可行的方案。这些结果表明，预训练中优化器的增益并不会自动迁移到（KL蒸馏中）。
tldr: 本研究通过对四个Qwen师生模型对系统比较多种优化器，发现预训练中矩阵结构优化器的增益并不能自动迁移到短程KL蒸馏任务，AdamW在质量与训练时间的权衡上依然表现最佳。
en_tdlr: Systematic comparisons across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs show that matrix-structured optimizer gains from pretraining do not automatically transfer to short-horizon KL distillation, with AdamW generally remaining the strongest choice in the quality-versus-training-time trade-off.
